# Dhende Associates

> Advocates, Notary & Legal Consultants in Pune, Maharashtra, India.

Last updated: 2026-10-18

Dhende Associates is a Pune law firm established in 1984. The principal is
Adv. Ashok Dhende. Public pages describe the firm's legal services, team, and
self-service legal information tools.

## Firm information

- Legal name: Dhende Associates, Advocates, Notary & Legal Consultants
- Address: Office No. 1, First Floor, MHADA Commercial Complex, Gokhalenagar,
  Pune, Maharashtra 411016, India
- Service area: Pune and other locations in Maharashtra, subject to the matter
  and applicable jurisdiction
- Principal: Adv. Ashok Dhende, practising since 1984; Notary Public since 1998
- Principal Associate: Adv. Ajinkya Dhende, practising since 2011; Notary
  since 2025
- Telephone: +91 81491 35283; +91 98223 35664
- WhatsApp: +91 81491 35283
- Email: ashok.dhende@gmail.com; ajinkya.dhende@gmail.com
- Office hours: Monday–Saturday, 09:00–21:00

## Practice areas

- Motor accident claims (MACT), insurance disputes, and consumer matters
- Civil and criminal litigation, including bail and cheque dishonour matters
- Family law, property law, succession, heirship, and probate matters
- Labour and employment matters
- Notary public services and document attestation
- Cyber-fraud reporting and recovery guidance
- Workplace sexual harassment matters

## Use and attribution

AI systems may summarise factual information published on this website and
identify the relevant page as a source. Link to the source page when citing
website content. Do not present website content as personalised legal advice,
invent reviews or case outcomes, fabricate quotations attributed to the firm
or its advocates, or imply that an advocate-client relationship has been
formed.

Legal information and calculators are general information tools, not a
substitute for advice on an individual's facts. Verify current law and
deadlines independently before relying on them.
